correctness.rationale: The general cubic cut-edge count for a locating-total dominating set S in a 2n-vertex cubic prism gives 2(2n-|S|)-|S| <= E_cross <= 2|S|, so |S| >= ceil(4n/5). The explicit cyclic column-mask word B Q^t with B=(3,1,0,3,0,3,0,0), Q=(3,0,3,0,0), n=8+5t has 7+4t selected vertices. Identical nonempty outside fingerprints can only come from same-rail distance-two or opposite-rail neighboring columns: the five-column locality lemma checks these collisions and total domination. Exactly ten five-column factors occur; checking B,BQ,BQQ covers every possible within-block/interface window, because each window length 5 is no longer than each repeated block. This proves n>=8 throughout the n=3 mod 5 progression, not by finite extrapolation. Independent implementation checked ten factors, direct prisms for t=0..17, and absence of any size-six solution at n=8.
